findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: «Від 31 числа пишуться трьома словами з y.»
findings.description: The range statement incorrectly includes exact tens such as 40 and 50, which are single words. The following sentence lists those tens separately but does not clearly delimit the three-word rule.
findings.suggestion: Specify that the conventional three-word pattern applies to numbers from 31 to 99 with nonzero units; exact tens remain single words.

items.notes: Teaching the usual separated spelling is appropriate. Less common accepted joined spellings need not be introduced here.
sources: Packet: content.body.scope.forms includes «cuarenta» and «cincuenta».

findings.description: Docena denotes twelve items. Ukrainian «десяток» denotes ten, so the gloss falsely equates two different quantities; adding «(12)» does not make «десяток» mean twelve.
findings.suggestion: Use «дюжина (12 штук)» and correct the corresponding prerequisite gloss wherever it is reused.

items.notes: This finding concerns the lexeme being reviewed; its unrelated repetition in other cases' prerequisite metadata does not independently invalidate those learner tasks.

findings.location: content.body.noteUk: «Від 31 — трьома словами: treinta y uno, treinta y dos…»
findings.description: The unrestricted rule includes subsequent exact tens such as cuarenta, which are single words.
findings.suggestion: Restrict the note to 31–39, or explicitly describe compound tens with nonzero units and distinguish exact tens.

findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s4].blocks[0].text: «Від 31 до 99 — три слова з y: treinta y uno, cuarenta y cinco.»; steps[id=s14].blocks[0].items[0]: «31–99 — з y (treinta y uno)»
findings.description: Both range statements include exact tens such as 40, 50 and 60, which neither contain y nor consist of three words.
findings.suggestion: State that the conventional tens + y + units pattern applies when the units are nonzero; exact tens are single words. Make the same distinction in the summary.

items.notes: Also reconcile the declared prerequisite order: question.word.cuanto lists quant.mucho as a prerequisite, but the lesson introduces cuánto in s6 and mucho/poco in s9. Either reorder these introductions or remove the unnecessary dependency if earlier agreement teaching suffices.

findings.description: The Ukrainian prompt incorrectly presents ten and twelve eggs as equivalent. The intended answer una docena de huevos expresses twelve.
findings.suggestion: Use «Дюжина яєць (12 штук)» if retaining the existing key.

items.reviewerAnswer: The prompt gives incompatible quantities: «десяток» corresponds to diez huevos; «дюжина» corresponds to una docena de huevos.
items.notes: The Spanish answer and its construction are correct for a dozen.

findings.description: Half of ten is five, whereas half a dozen is six. The parenthetical incorrectly equates these quantities.
findings.suggestion: Use «Півдюжини яєць (6 штук)» if retaining media docena de huevos.

items.reviewerAnswer: The prompt gives incompatible quantities: half of «десяток» is cinco huevos; «півдюжини» is media docena de huevos, or six eggs.
items.notes: The Spanish agreement media docena is correct.

findings.location: clips[0].translationUk: «Кілограм помідорів і десяток яєць, будь ласка.»; task.options[id=a].label and task.hints[kind=reveal].blocks[0].text: «Кілограм помідорів і десяток яєць.»
findings.description: Una docena means twelve items, but «десяток» means ten. Consequently the translation and reveal are wrong, and option a is incorrectly marked correct.
findings.suggestion: Use «Кілограм помідорів і дюжину яєць, будь ласка.» for the clip translation and the corresponding wording without «будь ласка» for option a and the reveal.

findings.location: task.hints[kind=translation].blocks[0].text: «У моєї сестри двадцять сім книжок англійською.»
findings.description: Libros de inglés ordinarily denotes books for studying English. The translation instead specifies books written in English, which would be libros en inglés.
findings.suggestion: Translate the supplied Spanish as «У моєї сестри двадцять сім книжок з англійської мови.» Alternatively, change the Spanish to libros en inglés if the existing Ukrainian meaning is intended.

findings.location: task.errors[id=e1].feedbackUk: «Від 31 пишемо трьома словами: cuarenta y cinco.»
findings.description: The general rule includes exact tens above 31, such as cuarenta, which are single words. The answer for 45 is correct, but the feedback overgeneralizes its pattern.
findings.suggestion: Explain the actual error locally: «У цьому записі пишемо три слова: cuarenta y cinco.» For a general rule, explicitly exclude exact tens and describe this as the conventional separated spelling.

items.notes: The reviewed error cuarentaycinco is incorrect; the recognized joined spelling uses i: cuarentaicinco. Because the key is not closed, omission of that alternative is not an automatic rejection.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «cardinales», spelling of compound cardinals (from memory).

findings.location: task.slots[id=s2].errors[0].feedbackUk: «Від 31 пишемо трьома словами: treinta y cinco.»
findings.description: The unrestricted three-word rule includes exact tens such as 40, which are single words. The answer for 35 is correct, but the explanation overgeneralizes.
findings.suggestion: Use local feedback such as «У цьому записі пишемо три слова: treinta y cinco.» A general explanation should distinguish exact tens from compound tens with nonzero units.

items.reviewerAnswer: En el museo hay doscientas fotos y treinta y cinco mapas.
items.notes: Doscientas correctly agrees with fotos. The reviewed error treintaycinco is incorrect; the accepted joined spelling uses i: treintaicinco.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «cardinales», spelling of compound cardinals (from memory).
